rules.name: 'Alles für Deutschland!'
rules.description: The German player can elect to use any of the special, non-numbered BR counters as a 'Beyond the Call of Duty' test, and play it on any of their units as normal. The only exception to this rule is the 'Endkampf' counter, which must be played as normal.

rules.name: German Defender
rules.description: In any game, the German player can always choose to be the defender in an Attack/Defense scenario rather than face the enemy in a Meeting Engagement or be the attacker themself.

rules.name: Panzer Ace
rules.description: Upgrade a tank or assault gun chosen from the Tanks or Specialist Support Units section of the army list to a Panzer Ace.  This tank becomes Elite, and gains +1 to hit with Aimed Fire from its main gun (both HE and AP shells).

rules.name: Atypical Tank
rules.description: A Defenders of the Reich battlegroup can include a single 'Atypical' tank or assault gun.  An Atypical unit can be selected from the Tank or Specialist Suport Unit section of any German army list, for the points and BR given, and can include any of its normal upgrades.  The Atypical tank cannot already be included in the Defence of the Reich army list.

rules.name: Atypical Infantry Platoon or Squad
rules.description: A Defenders of the Reich battlegroup can include a single, 'Atypical,' platoon or squad.  An Atypical unit can be selected from the Infantry section of any German army list, for the points and BR given, and can include and of its normal upgrades and platoon support options.  This could include Fallshirmjäger, Gebirgsjäger, SS, training units, Kriegsmarine, etc.

rules.name: Remote Control Demolition
rules.description:
A Remote Control Demolition vehicle is given orders as part of its command unit’s orders. Rather than order the command unit itself, the commander can instead choose to move a single vehicle by remote control. First the command vehicle must pass a Communication check (2+). If it fails the remote vehicle fails to act and the order is lost. If it passes, the remote vehicle may make a normal move.

Once the move is complete, the commander can choose to detonate (or not) as part of the same order. Any unit, defence, minefield marker or building the remote vehicle is in contact with is automatically hit. The explosion has an HE rating of 10/2+ and an Armour Penetration value of 13. Any minefield markers within 5" of the exploding vehicle model are removed from play, as is the vehicle itself. Once detonated,
a remote controlled vehicle cannot be repaired! If you have a model of a crater, place it where the vehicle once was.

rules.name: Spotter
rules.description: Spotter: A sniper with a spotter increases its maximum range from 30" to 40", hitting on a 6.

rules.name: Captured Vehicle
rules.description: A single captured enemy tank can be included as a Specialist Support Unit.  It must be taken from the Tank section of the army list you will be fighting against; Russian, British, or American.  This tank cannot be rated as Restricted or Unique in that list.  The captured vehicle cannot be resupplied during the game.

rules.name: HVSS
rules.description: A tank with Horizontal Volume Suspension Springs (HVSS) increases its cross-country and road movement distances by 1".  This will already be included in the vehicle's data profile.

sharedRules.name: Restricted - West
sharedRules.description: This is the same as the standard Restricted rule, except it only applies if the battlegroup will be facing an American or British battlegroup.  It does not apply when facing a Russian battlegroup.

sharedRules.name: Vampir
sharedRules.description: In a night fight game, a Nachtjäger sniper equipped with a 'Vampir' ZG-1229 IR scope can use it for Aimed Fire up to 30" and always requires a 2+ to spot its target, regardless of the target's firing or cover.

sharedRules.name: Uhu
sharedRules.description: If a Panther tank equipped with the FG 1250 IR scope has a target that is also in the line of sight of a Uhu Sd.Kfz. 251/20, then its spotting advantage is increased from 30" to 50".

sharedRules.name: FG 1250
sharedRules.description: A Panther tank equipped with the FG 1250 IR sight can spot and target enemy units up to 30" away using the normal rules, as if it was daylight.  Targets over 30" cannot be spotted or targeted, as per the night fighting rules.
